title: Heuristics in risky decision-making relate to preferential representation of information MEG data
description: This dataset contains MEG recordings from participants performing a risky decision-making task alongside a localizer task and a probability learning task. It was collected to investigate heuristics in risky decision-making and their relationship to preferential neural representation of choice- and outcome-related information. The dataset includes raw MEG data and derivative event and epoched data tables supporting analyses reported in an associated preprint.
methods_description: Participants completed 13 MEG scanner runs comprising a localizer task, a non-analyzed probability learning task, and a risky decision-making task. Event timing was recorded via a photodiode channel and processed to determine onset times, which are provided in derivative event tables. Epoched preprocessed data were generated for the localizer task and around choice events in the main task, epoched from 0-500 ms following each event.
